sources.snippet: The most notable models in the series currently include: MiniCPM-V 4.6: 🔥🔥🔥 The latest and most efficient model in the MiniCPM-V series. With a total of 1.3B parameters, it surpasses larger models like Gemma4-E2B-it in performance, while showing superior efficiency than smaller models like Qwen3.5-0.8B (achieving ~1.5x token throughput).

sources.title: MiniCPM-V-4.6 - model.xinference.io
sources.snippet: MiniCPM-V 4.6 is the latest and most edge-deployment-friendly model in the MiniCPM-V series, with only 1.3B parameters (1.3B activated). It is built on SigLIP2-400M and Qwen3.5-0.8B, and supports single-image, multi-image, and video understanding.

sources.title: mlx-vlm/mlx_vlm/models/minicpmv4_6/README.md at main - GitHub
sources.snippet: MiniCPM-V 4.6 is an edge-oriented vision-language model for efficient image, multi-image, and video understanding. It combines a SigLIP2-400M vision encoder with a Qwen3.5-0.8B language model and supports mixed 4x / 16x visual token compression so applications can trade finer detail for faster inference.
